reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Cert-manager now uses a local fork of the `golang.org/x/crypto/acme` package", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The release note states only that cert-manager uses a local fork of the acme package; it describes no operational consequence for operators.

proposed.statement: Cert-manager now uses a local fork of the golang.org/x/crypto/acme package; this is an internal dependency change with no stated operator impact.
